name: Okita Souji
source:
Captain of the Shinsen-gumi First Corps. He's well-known as a gifted swordsman. He doesn't get attached to things, and is so indifferent he often forgets to eat. He is a little odd, and says that one of his hobbies is teasing Yamazaki. But it seems as though something is hidden behind that carefree smile of his.

[Taken from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
